Job Description: 
 
 INNOVATE without boundaries !   At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success -- so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to   create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our engineering teams .     

     

 As a Manufacturing Software Platform Engineer , you will lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced manufacturing software and controls solutions with a strong focus on global platform development and cross-site standardization. This role is responsible for driving scalable, reusable solutions that are adopted across manufacturing sites while influencing technical direction and alignment across AME, IT, and operations teams. You will play a critical role in executing the Global Software and Connectivity Platforms strategy, acting as a technical leader and key partner in driving global adoption, governance, and long-term platform success, with the opportunity to grow into a lead role supporting global platform direction.   
   

 Summary   

   

 This role is a critical member of the Global Software and Connectivity Platforms team, responsible for leading execution and adoption of scalable solutions across manufacturing sites while developing into a key technical leader supporting global platform strategy and direction.   


   

 Your   Impact :     

   

 Design and deploy controls, software, and electrical systems   in manufacturing   

 
 Lead execution of global software and connectivity platform initiatives across multiple manufacturing sites   

 
 Drive commissioning, validation (FAT/SAT), and multi-site deployment of standardized solutions   

 
 Contribute to and own components of scalable global software platforms and reusable architectures   

 
 Develop machine-to-system connectivity (PLC, IPC, databases, MES) aligned to global platform standards   

 
 Enable real-time data integration into manufacturing and enterprise systems to support global visibility and decision-making   

 
 Implement digital poka-yoke and process enforcement solutions aligned with platform strategy   

 
 Drive adoption of global standards across sites by influencing site AME, IT, and operations leaders   

 
 Support high-complexity engineering and platform initiatives with feasibility, architecture input, and cost analysis   

 
 Collaborate across global teams and suppliers to ensure alignment to platform direction and successful deployment at scale   

 
 

 Competencies and Personal Attributes:   


   

 Agility — Embraces change and thrives in evolving global platform strategy   

 
 Passionate and Energetic — Driven to deliver scalable, high-impact global solutions   

 
 Entrepreneurial — Ownership of platform initiatives and drives adoption beyond direct authority   

 
 Drive for Results — Executes and delivers across multiple sites and stakeholders   

 
 Team Oriented — Leads through influence across global teams and functions   

 
 Delivery — Translates strategy into execution with measurable global impact   

 
 Influence & Leadership — Ability to align and influence site leaders and stakeholders   

 
   

 What You Bring :   

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering   (Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or related)   

 
 3 – 5   years of experience in automation, controls, or manufacturing software   

 
 Experience with   text-based , LabVIEW, or   PLC   programming   

 
 Experience working across teams or functions to deliver solutions   

 
 Experience with manufacturing documentation (theory of operation, schematics, manuals)   

 
 Software source control   

 

   

 Preferred Experience :   

   

 Experience developing & deploying scalable software solutions across multiple sites   

 
 Experience influencing or working with global stakeholders (AME, IT, operations)   

 
 Data connectivity, MES, or manufacturing software system s   

 
 Machine-to-database integration, industrial communication protocols   

 
 Robotics,   vision systems , and   advanced automation   

 
 HMI development and configuration   

 
 Database and data-driven application experience   

 
 Understanding of lean manufacturing, quality systems, and error-proofing   

 
 Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects   

 
 Industrial automation experience   

 
 Experience supporting or leading global deployments or standardization efforts   

 
   

 Working Conditions   


   

 Travel Requirements:   

 Ability to travel internationally and domestically as required   

 
 1 0 -20 % (includes domestic and international   travel   for machine and/or concept evaluations )   

 
   

 We provide these great perks and benefits:     

 Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans   

 
 Generous 401 (K) savings plan   

 
 Education assistance   

 
 On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service   

 
 And many more, check out our benefits site  HERE   

 

 
 
 Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.
